transcript: Wonderful Town is such a random musical but simultaneously makes sense as one that's now been in New York City Center seven times. In this Encores revival, two sisters from Ohio played by Anika Noni Rose and Aisha Jackson have just moved to New York and are looking to make their dreams come true. They encounter an eclectic group of people in their pursuits of career success, new beginnings, and maybe even love. It’s a charming portrait of the classic New York aspirations that you see in all sorts of media, but like I said, this show is very random. For example, there's a whole song about football, a song about the conga, and a song involving Irish step dancing. Like a lot of musicals of its time, the plot here is a little aimless but a sufficient vehicle for the song and dance of it all. And this is a pretty solid production — I thought the relatively stripped-back direction and costumes were creative and the choreography was very fun. Our leading ladies Anika and Aisha are both great and very easy to watch, though I wish they had more time to sing together other than their two duets, since their voices together are just spectacular. This production fulfills the Encores mission really well, especially with its score that benefits from a full orchestra. Wonderful Town is running at City Center through next Sunday, May 11th. With that, other program for my collection.
